integrity: Mathematical proof with symbolic/numerical reproducibility; self-review only; independence and publication priority not certified.
scientific_limitations: Instantaneous Poisson resets to nearest site of infinite regular lattice; stationary asymptotic cumulant growth, not finite-time kurtosis, irregular arrays, biased ratchets, or inference. Prior first-passage transform and generic renewal theory are used, not new.
title: A strict fourth-cumulant sign law for diffusion with periodic nearest-site resetting
